decisions.reason: The net price display plugin is a simple extension close to the core offer, but its absence from the website in 2020 and 2021 suggests the firm has learned it adds little distinct value, likely as shop platforms move to new versions, so the development effort is better redeployed.

The ERP interface draws on the firm's integration know-how, fits its multichannel direction and meets recurring client needs that its own development team can keep refining, so it is worth keeping despite its lower visibility on the website.
